name: plan
use_for: Before starting work: goal, steps, risks.
guide:
Use this before a larger piece of work so the owner can correct course early.

- **goal**: what will be true when you are done.
- **steps**: a checklist of steps in order. Mark done ones as you go if you repost.
- **diagram**: a Mermaid diagram when structure or flow matters.
- **risks**: what could go wrong or take longer.
- **questions**: what you need the owner to answer before or during the work.

Tip: keep steps small enough that each can be checked.

slots.name: goal
slots.label: Goal
slots.hint: What will be true when done

slots.name: diagram
slots.label: Diagram
slots.hint: Mermaid diagram of structure or flow

example.goal: Users can sign in with GitHub as well as email.

steps.text: Sign-in button on web and Android

diagram.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  User->>App: Sign in with GitHub
  App->>GitHub: Redirect
  GitHub->>App: Callback with code
  App->>User: Session

risks: Users with the same email on both methods need linking rules
questions: Should GitHub sign-in be allowed on self-hosted servers by default?
